referenceFunction.includedProcesses:
Offshore substation of a 1005 MW offshore wind farm. Included processes: manufacturing, transports, installation, replacements, decommission and waste treatement. Calculated for FU of 1p. Data are based on a fictitious offshore wind farm consisting of 67 wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 15 MW, as defined in the Renewable Energy Material Property Database, REMPD.
Main data source for material composition: Renewable Energy Material Property Database, REMPD (Cooperman et al., 2023)
referenceFunction.name: Substation, offshore, 1005MW offshore wind farm
